title: Stage 2 actor service observation verification
scope: Verify behavior-neutral actor-service and selected send-side buffer-copy observation, bounded epoch aggregation, versioned post-service publication, Stage 1 and Stage 2 joins, append-only raw export, explicit missing state, sink isolation, legacy identity, and preservation of shard scheduling and ownership. Do not verify or authorize a forceable quantum, distinct buffer strategy, fairness rule, backpressure rule, performance claim, or active behavior.
verification_method: Canonical SpecTrace validation, deterministic requirement-home tests, schema and semantic validation, and focused existing shard, deadline, application-send queue, ownership, stream-capacity, flow-control, metrics, cancellation, disposal, retransmission, and terminal correctness tests.
preconditions: The unified four-axis Stage 1 smoke and append-only materialization checkpoint remain preserved.
Receive-credit publication and every applied adaptive policy remain legacy_current.
The stopped 55,658-row send-turn-only normalization remains diagnostic_incomplete and is not restarted.
CI remains correctness-only and performance evidence remains manual or nightly.
Active_internal and production activation remain unauthorized.
procedure: Validate SPEC-QUIC-CRT-STAGE2-ACTOR-MEMORY, ARC-QUIC-CRT-0067, WI-QUIC-CRT-0068, and VER-QUIC-CRT-0069 against the canonical model and check reciprocal trace links.
Build the test project in Release before running the Stage 2 requirement home.
Verify exact disabled and observe-only mode and sink pairing.
Verify one connection-local monotonic observation per observed shard dispatch with closed wake, work, disposition, phase, and validity values.
Verify queue, service, pending-work, effect, and follow-on attribution plus saturating bounded epoch accumulation and reset.
Verify observation and epoch JSON against their schemas and semantic count and sequence rules.
Verify a throwing sink cannot interrupt actor progress or ownership release.

Verify buffer-copy records remain selected and applied legacy_current with null force and shadow identity, one buffer-lifetime latch, and explicit missing terminal-release, retained-age, and pool-outstanding state.
Verify fixed-field buffer-copy aggregation across retry, oversized raw queue, formatted payload, combined send, and sent-plaintext retention paths.

Verify the v2 closed buffer contract, fixed epoch counters, owned path-migration retransmission-clone producer, and new or capacity-reusing receive-segment producer while retained v1 schemas remain unchanged.
Verify hosted-shard epoch publication occurs after actor observation and work-item resource release, while independent-consumer publication occurs after connection-event resource release.
Verify post-service boundary version, execution source, disposition, actor-publication state, release completion, and explicit missing or fault validity.
Verify connection-observation, receive-credit, boundary, Stage 1, actor, and buffer summaries seal under one monotonic connection epoch key and invalid joins are rejected before accumulator reset.
Verify post-service boundary and unified internal evidence JSON against their versioned schemas.
Verify the raw host configures one accumulator for receive-credit, all four Stage 1, actor-service, and buffer-copy evidence on every adaptive execution.
Verify append-only unified raw export retains exact connection keys, four Stage 1 records, actor and buffer summaries, source hashes, validation counts, and a schema-valid manifest.
Verify duplicate, out-of-order, mismatched-join, multi-axis, and bounded-channel export failures cannot be accepted as complete evidence.
Verify compact buffer lifetime tokens carry no object identity, move with the existing owner, distinguish clones, and are consumed once at authoritative terminal return boundaries.

Verify release records retain original operation sequence and path, closed reason, released capacity, bounded lifetime, lifecycle, and explicit invalid state while evidence failure cannot prevent return.
Verify maintained application-send queue retained count, capacity, and oldest enqueue time across enqueue, replacement, removal with and without return, transfer, and clear.
Verify maintained retransmission queue retained-owner count, capacity, and oldest sent time across enqueue, every discard or suppression path, dequeue ownership transfer, and shared-owner release.

Verify maintained sent-packet retained-owner count, capacity, and oldest sent time across insert, packet-number replacement, owner detachment, acknowledgment, discard, loss, and retransmission ownership transfer.
Verify buffer-copy schema capacity, segment, count, sequence, identity, and semantic invariants and listener option propagation.
Run the existing shard, deadline, work-item layout, receive-buffer ownership, stream-capacity, flow-control, and metrics correctness band.
Keep runnable connection count, oldest shard item age, deadline lateness, and useful work units explicitly missing until their reviewed seams exist.
expected_result: Actor-service and selected send-side buffer-copy evidence is versioned, bounded, connection-attributable, schema-valid, semantically validated, and behavior-neutral; missing inputs remain explicit; legacy shard drain, copy, timer, recovery, terminal, progress, and ownership behavior remains authoritative; and no forceable or active Stage 2 policy is introduced.
status_summary: In progress. Independent observe-only actor-service and buffer-copy connection contracts, versioned records, bounded epoch accumulators, schemas, semantic validators, listener propagation, and deterministic tests are implemented. Buffer v2 preserves retained v1 schemas and adds verified owned path-migration retransmission-clone plus new and capacity-reusing receive-segment producers through a guarded connection-local observer. Receive-segment owners now carry compact lifetime tokens through partial reads and emit exactly one delivery or reset record after authoritative return. Flow-control retry request owners carry tokens through replacement, downstream copy, completion, failure, cancellation, terminal completion, disposal, and defensive recycle. Construction and release raw records join exactly by connection key and operation sequence, while bounded writer failures remain explicit. Eligible epoch publication now occurs at a versioned post-service boundary after actor publication and resource release; one guarded accumulator validates exact monotonic connection-observation, receive-credit, boundary, Stage 1, actor, and buffer joins before reset. The permanent raw host configures that accumulator for every adaptive execution and the append-only exporter retains joined rows, compatibility streams, exact keys, source hashes, counts, manifests, and explicit invalid-contract export failures. The application-send queue, sent-packet store, and retransmission queue maintain total retained count, capacity, and oldest time across existing ownership transitions, removing their total retention snapshot scans. Runnable connection count, oldest shard item age, deadline lateness, reviewed useful work units, terminal-release correlation for remaining owners, copy-scope retained age, pool outstanding state, complete fairness outcomes, a distinct conservative buffer value, and every forceable Stage 2 policy remain open. No active behavior is authorized.
